body: It should probably start the timer if it was stopped previously
I disagree. A setter should just be a setter, nothing more. If you want to start the timer, call start()

I think that in the case of setting the time remaining to a positive number if it was already zero should actually set a timer for that amount of time. If this isn't the case then this should probably be warned somewhere

@lodetrick you're right. I guess it makes no sense on setting the property if its going to be left stopped, yet again synchronization might be happening in the background. Warning should be fine I guess

This can be a failure, not a warning.

```suggestion
	ERR_FAIL_COND_V(!processing, vformat("Setting time_left when the timer is stopped. Use start(time_left) to start automatically"));
```

Fail hard, rather than trying to support an edge case that doesn't make sense.

I dont think its an edge case so much, and also it doesn't break anything per se, or need to avoid it in any way.
But, yeah, I can change it anyway and in the future will see
I think the previous USAGE was fine. There is no reason to edit this in the inspector, and IMO no reason to serialize the value.
Nitpick: it is godot style to only put the ERR_FAIL macro and not the if () statement. The macro contains the if (!processing) check internally, so the if statement is redundant

```suggestion
	ADD_PROPERTY(PropertyInfo(Variant::FLOAT, "time_left", PROPERTY_HINT_NONE, "suffix:s", PROPERTY_USAGE_NONE), "set_time_left", "get_time_left");
```
Incorrect, it should be a usage, not a hint

```suggestion
	ERR_FAIL_COND_MSG(!processing, "Setting time_left when the timer is stopped. Use start(time_left) to start automatically.");
```
Per the format of errors, also no need for `vformat` if not used to actually format
really sorry. updated it
btw the suffix doesn't make sense here.

body:
Mentioning "getters" and "setters" is always a bit weird. For the layman user they're just accessing a property, whether it be by getting or setting it.

The following should convey the same idea without being too long for this simple concept:
```suggestion
			The timer's remaining time in seconds. This is always [code]0.0[/code] if the timer is stopped.
			[b]Note:[/b] It is not possible to set this property while the timer is stopped.
```

This is for consistency with a similar error message in the same node.
```suggestion
	ERR_FAIL_COND_MSG(!processing, "Unable to set time_left when the timer is stopped. Use `start(time_left)` instead.");
```
